title: Korean Beef Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional tacos, featuring marinated Korean-style beef, roasted vegetables, and a zesty slaw.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables (such as carrots, bell peppers, and onions)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chili flakes, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Add sliced beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss roasted vegetables with a drizzle of oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove beef from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing cooked beef onto a tortilla, followed by roasted vegetables, zesty slaw, and a drizzle of ssam sauce. Garnish with green onions and cilantro.
